newsitem.title: ITALY: Netanyahu says Israel has potential to double GDP.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu says Israel has potential to double GDP.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday that Israel was chained by a highly-regulated economy but had the potential for rapid growth as its liberalisation and privatisation plans took root.

"The potential we have today could easily double in 12 years -- we could easily have GDP of $34,000," he told a forum of Italian businessmen in Rome, referring to Israel's current gross domestic product of $17,000 per capita.
Netanyahu said Israel was "chained by a very regulated economy". He said liberalisation would be like "if you take a coiled spring and you release it and the energy comes out".
He said his rightist government was pushing ahead with a very rapid privatisation programme which aimed to sell off key state-owned bodies within the next two to three years.
"We are leaving the hardest to the end but we are going to do it," said Netanyahu.
"We are going to go from A if not to Z, but to Y. We are going to get there and in the next three years."
